source: 2026-11-12 event expansion (gameplay-programmer): +50 pool_new rows, +6 followups, +12 C steps, 4 rows moved from pool_kept. 2026-11-03 chain-data (economy-designer): per core 4.2/4.3 and economy 8.1/8.2/8.3. DATA ONLY; the Gameplay Programmer reads this. All numbers are balance keys in data/balance.json.

vocabulary.signs: every key value is signed in the direction of the real change: cash -150 pays 150; volume_pct -0.05 = 5% less volume; upkeep_pct +0.2 = 20% more ship upkeep; price_pct -0.08 = 8% lower sell prices; trip_cost_pct +0.33 = one route costs 33% more trip cost. Gets lists contain the good effects, costs the bad ones, but the sign is always in the value.
vocabulary.cycles: cycles_key names a balance key with a cycle count; 99 means the rest of the run.

player_effect_types.volume_pct: {key, cycles_key} multiplies the player's volume in the step's market for n cycles; stacks multiplicatively
player_effect_types.price_pct: {key, cycles_key} changes the sell prices of the step's market for n cycles (cash only, share counts base prices)
player_effect_types.upkeep_pct: {key, cycles_key} changes ship upkeep (base maintenance) for n cycles
player_effect_types.trip_cost_pct: {key, cycles_key, scope one_route} changes the trip cost of ONE route (the busiest route of that market) for n cycles
player_effect_types.tech_units: {key} crafting progress units in that market's workshop
player_effect_types.workshop_idle: {cycles_key} the market's workshop makes no batch for n cycles
player_effect_types.workshop_batches: {key, cycles_key} extra batches per cycle for n cycles (adds to workshop_batches_per_cycle)
player_effect_types.storage: RESERVED, not used by any of the 28 steps (economy 8.1 has no storage cell)

vocabulary.bot_effect: {bot bot_1..3, market, stat strength|growth|tier, size S|M|L (null for tier), key, direction up|down, optional cycles_key}. key resolves the size: event_hit_strength_S/M/L and event_hit_growth_S/M/L (down), event_hit_strength_up_S/M and event_hit_growth_up_S (up), event_hit_tier (tier -1; on a tier-1 bot becomes strength down M, summary R8). With cycles_key the hit is timed (strength x (1 - value) for n cycles, then restored); otherwise permanent and multiplicative. Tier is only ever cut.
vocabulary.trigger: a condition tree of game/conditions.gd (one vocabulary for chains, availability, events and goods). Atoms are strings 'name:arg': any_tier:<n> (some world reached prosperity tier n) and bazaar_stage:<n> (n Star Bazaar stages done) are the growth triggers; share_pct:balance.<key> is legacy, kept for old data, no data uses it; first_sale_after_cycle:balance.<key> (first sale of a non-common-raw good of the market after that cycle); cycles_after_prev_step:balance.<key> (n cycles since the previous step of the SAME chain fired); skill_learned:<node> (skill or tech node, e.g. MIL_2); event_fired:<event or step id>; more in the header of game/conditions.gd. Trees: {all:[...]}, {any:[...]}, {not: cond}. A bare atom string is that atom. A step or an option may carry visible_when (same trees); it is only offered while true. Steps with requires_prev_step true can only fire after the previous step of the same chain (A2 after A1 ...). Every step also needs min_gap (balance key chain_min_gap, 3 cycles) since the last chain step of that market, and a chain step takes the event slot before any pool event.
vocabulary.dir: signed nudge base value from core 4.3 before echo, swing and cap; rules in balance keys dir_echo_mult, dir_swing_mult, dir_swing_min_abs, dir_nudge_cap. Order: echo, swing, cap. Never shown to the player.
vocabulary.win_gate: a market's win is not declared before its B4 fired or cycle win_gate_cycle (78) is reached.
vocabulary.pool: 2026-11-12: pool_new rows may carry choices (data choice events) and visible_when; followups are scheduled-only popups. Chain steps now: A1-A3, B1-B4 and C1-C3 per market (C1 at system_open:2 and any_tier:3, C2 at bazaar_stage:2, C3 at bazaar_stage:3).

pool_new_note: effects and numbers marked picked are mine (core 4.4 gives only the idea, story gives text for EV40, 43, 46, 49, 50). 2026-11-12 event expansion: 60 pool_new rows (10 first-pass rows plus 50 from the story-designer plan handoffs/story-designer/2026-11-11-event-expansion.json). A row is a plain event (effect: price_pct, planet_closed, shortage or congestion at a planet id, texts EV<nn>_TITLE and _BODY) or a choice event (choices: [{key, effect, follow_id?}]; effect types price_pct, planet_closed, shortage, congestion, cash {key: signed balance key}, stock {planet, good, key}; texts <id>_<KEY>_BTN, _EFF, _TITLE and the popup <id>_<KEY>; read by game/events.gd). visible_when gates the row; branch-only rows carry branch_is:<market>. Followups (key followups) are plain popups scheduled only by a choice follow_id, never drawn at random. Planets for story names Quillon, Brannock, Mossfell are system 2 ids (s2_p4, s2_p1, s2_p3). bot_effect rule of the first pass: shortage (price up or closure) slows the market's lead bot (growth S or strength S down); glut (price down) lifts bot_3 strength S; the 50 new rows carry none.
pool_kept_note: 20 kept pool events: EV01-EV16, EV17, EV20, EV26, EV28 (EV21, EV22, EV24, EV25 moved to pool_new on 2026-11-12 to carry a gate). bot_effect is optional and small: price-up events slow the lead bot of the good's market (growth S down); EV20 asteroid hits bot_1 min growth S; closures, glut events and EV17 have none.
